description: Search Cdiscount by keyword, browse category and seller listings, read product pages or customer reviews.

brands.description: Filter by one or more brand names in search, category and seller modes, for example Samsung or Apple. Cdiscount brand filters are case-insensitive here.
brands.title: Brands

categoryUrls.description: Cdiscount category, department, brand or search listing URLs to browse in category mode. Example: https://www.cdiscount.com/telephonie/telephone-mobile/l-14404.html
categoryUrls.title: Category or listing URLs

condition.description: Keep new products only, or refurbished and used products only, in search, category and seller modes.
condition.title: Condition

freeShippingOnly.description: Keep only offers that display free shipping in search, category and seller modes.
freeShippingOnly.title: Free shipping only

includeDelivery.description: Add Cdiscount's delivery window and shipping options to each product record. This adds one request per product and uses Cdiscount's default signed-out address context.
includeDelivery.title: Include delivery estimates

includeDetails.description: For search, category, seller and topSellers modes, open each product page to add brand, description, specifications, EAN, seller stats, variants and recent reviews. This adds one request per product.
includeDetails.title: Include full product details

includeSponsored.description: Keep sponsored placements in search, category, seller and topSellers results. Turn off to skip them.
includeSponsored.title: Include sponsored products

keyword.description: Keyword to search for in search and topSellers modes. In category mode, an optional keyword narrows the listing to that keyword.
keyword.title: Search keyword

maxItems.description: Maximum number of product records to return across all queries and URLs. Reviews mode uses maxReviews instead.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPrice.description: Keep only products priced at or below this value, in euros, in search, category, seller and topSellers modes.
maxPrice.title: Max price (EUR)

maxReviews.description: Maximum number of customer reviews to return per product in reviews mode.
maxReviews.title: Max reviews per product

minPrice.description: Keep only products priced at or above this value, in euros, in search, category, seller and topSellers modes.
minPrice.title: Min price (EUR)

minRating.description: Keep products with at least this customer rating in search, category and seller modes. In reviews mode, only fetch reviews at or above this rating. Cdiscount applies the 3+ and 4+ filters server-side; 5 stars is checked on the returned records.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

mode.description: What to scrape. Search uses a keyword, category browses listing URLs, seller reads seller shops, productDetails reads product pages, reviews collects customer reviews, and topSellers searches by best sellers.
enumTitles: Get product details by URL or product ID
Get customer reviews by product URL or ID
mode.title: Mode

productUrls.description: Cdiscount product page URLs or product IDs used by productDetails and reviews modes. Example: https://www.cdiscount.com/telephonie/telephone-mobile/poco/f-14404-aadde58828.html or aadde58828
productUrls.title: Product URLs or IDs

sellerIds.description: Marketplace seller IDs or seller page URLs in seller mode. Example: 421705 or https://www.cdiscount.com/mpv-421705-vanterra-solutions.html
sellerIds.title: Seller IDs or URLs

soldByCdiscountOnly.description: Keep only offers sold directly by Cdiscount in search, category and seller modes.
soldByCdiscountOnly.title: Sold by Cdiscount only

sortBy.description: Result order used in search, category, seller and topSellers modes. 'rating' is Cdiscount's composite best-rated ranking, not a strict average-rating sort.
enumTitles: Newest first (legacy; mapped to relevance, or best sellers in topSellers mode)
sortBy.title: Sort by

title: Cdiscount Scraper Input
